source.detail: Closed-form Nan effective-medium conductivity of the reference DGEBA epoxy with 5 vol% randomly oriented graphene nanoplatelets (matrix 0.2 W/(m K); platelet 1200 W/(m K) in plane and 6 W/(m K) through plane, 5 um wide and 0.02 um thick; interface conductance 25 MW/(m^2 K), Kapitza radius 8.0 nm), after C.-W. Nan, R. Birringer, D. R. Clarke, H. Gleiter, J. Appl. Phys. 81, 6692 (1997), with the spherical limit checked against D. P. H. Hasselman, L. F. Johnson, J. Compos. Mater. 21, 508 (1987).
